OPERATIONS
==========

POWER ON/OFF
------------

.. image:: asset:operation/jbp2000b/power_control
   :alt: Battery Pack 2000 POWER button operation.
   :width: 360px

| **On**
| Press once
| **Off**
| Press and hold for 3 seconds

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 0
   :widths: 12 88

   * - **NOTE**
     - When used with |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|, the Battery Pack 2000 power state can be controlled through the main POWER button on |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.

       The product automatically shuts down when it is not charging and no load is connected for |DEFAULT_STANDBY_DURATION|.

LCD DISPLAY ON/OFF
------------------

.. image:: asset:operation/jbp2000b/lcd_control
   :alt: Battery Pack 2000 LCD display operation.
   :width: 360px

When you press the main POWER button or charge the product, the LCD display turns on. Press the main POWER button again to turn the LCD display off.
